plain_language_statement: MS involves immune-mediated injury in the central nervous system, including damage to myelin and nerve fibers.
allowed_scope: One-sentence orientation, explicitly labeled background rather than a result produced here.
forbidden_overread: Do not imply that V55 analyzed disease causation or settled every MS mechanism.

plain_language_statement: Relapse activity and disability progression are related but not interchangeable outcomes.
allowed_scope: Explain that relapses are episodes of inflammatory activity while progression asks about accumulated disability over time.
forbidden_overread: Do not imply that every patient follows one trajectory or that relapse has no relationship to disability.

plain_language_statement: The bounded APC/HLA-II early-treatment score is the project's one live clinical lead.
allowed_scope: Call it a provisional early monitoring signal awaiting independent validation.
forbidden_overread: Do not call it a validated biomarker, treatment selector, target, cure, or clinical tool.

plain_language_statement: The locked score produced mixed results across therapies and cohorts.
allowed_scope: State that the MS DMF cohort passed while fingolimod and psoriasis adalimumab did not; cross-disease tofacitinib support is bounded.
forbidden_overread: Do not describe the rule as broadly predictive across MS drugs, diseases, tissues, or outcomes.

plain_language_statement: Within its bounded 19-person evidence set, the simple locked score outperformed more flexible alternatives and survived several statistical stress tests.
allowed_scope: Explain tool robustness together with tiny-sample and external-validation caveats.
forbidden_overread: Do not imply that repeated analysis substitutes for an independent cohort or that flexible modeling was comprehensively ruled out.

plain_language_statement: The monitoring signal is not explained by the tested steroid-response or simple cell-composition signatures, but broader immune tone attenuates it.
allowed_scope: Describe it as partially confounded or immune-tone bounded, with direct caveats about marker proxies and n=19.
forbidden_overread: Do not call it a pure APC/HLA-II mechanism or claim direct steroid exposure was measured.

plain_language_statement: A monitoring signal can report whether biology is changing after treatment without identifying what drug target should be changed.
allowed_scope: Use monitoring-versus-target as a central conceptual distinction.
forbidden_overread: Do not convert predictive or pharmacodynamic association into causality, efficacy, or target evidence.

plain_language_statement: Among the tested autoimmune comparators, ulcerative colitis had the strongest genome-wide genetic relationship with MS.
allowed_scope: Present as useful, low-novelty genetic backdrop within the tested comparator set.
forbidden_overread: Do not claim UC is the cause of MS or that this relationship transfers a treatment target.

plain_language_statement: At ZMIZ1, the same expression-increasing direction was associated with higher MS risk but lower Crohn risk.
allowed_scope: Use as a warning that a shared locus can point in opposite disease directions.
forbidden_overread: Do not nominate ZMIZ1 as a treatment target from this comparison.

plain_language_statement: The chr1 KIF21B/GPR25 region appears biologically real, but causal-gene uncertainty and restoration or up-function direction make it therapeutically hard.
allowed_scope: Explain that tractability depends on the genetically required direction, not just protein class or pocket shape.
forbidden_overread: Do not call GPR25 actionable because it resembles a GPCR or KIF21B closed because it is a kinesin.

plain_language_statement: PTGER4 was closed as a simple shared MS-UC target because multiple signals and disease directions conflict.
allowed_scope: Use as the clearest example of druggability failing to rescue ambiguous causal direction.
forbidden_overread: Do not reopen it without signal-specific cell-type QTL and a favorable MS direction.

plain_language_statement: GPR25 was demoted from an early favorite after denser immune-QTL and direction review.
allowed_scope: Show the project's willingness to reverse an attractive initial interpretation.
forbidden_overread: Do not erase that chr1 remains real biology or imply GPR25 was proven irrelevant.

plain_language_statement: A coupled APC remodeling pattern recurs across the held data, linking HLA-II, IFN/APC, MIF/CD74-related state, IFN readout, and lysosomal processing.
allowed_scope: Present as a recurring mechanistic architecture useful for interpretation and assay design.
forbidden_overread: Do not present the axis, any component, or a multi-node combination as a validated target or successor rule.

plain_language_statement: Adding coupled-axis features or flexible multifeature models did not improve the locked monitoring score.
allowed_scope: Explain that more complexity did not buy better validated performance in these small data.
forbidden_overread: Do not claim simplicity is always superior or no future model could improve with new data.

plain_language_statement: The project could not validate a broad patient-level immune-state simulator from the held data.
allowed_scope: Explain that bounded directional priors remain possible, but patient prediction and unseen-pathway simulation are unsupported.
forbidden_overread: Do not describe all computational modeling as useless.

plain_language_statement: Joint inference recovered the already-known APC and immune-tone structures but no unexpected held-out-validated signal.
allowed_scope: State that zero of 22 unexpected candidates passed the joint recurrence-plus-holdout gate and the corpus-specific 95% upper bound was 0.127.
forbidden_overread: Do not call 0.127 a biological effect limit or claim all future public data and methods are exhausted.

plain_language_statement: The rational discovery boundary is new data rather than more unconstrained mining of the same held corpus.
allowed_scope: Frame this as a decision about the assembled corpus and gate, not a universal ban on computation.
forbidden_overread: Do not prevent targeted re-analysis, validation, or analysis of genuinely new public datasets.

plain_language_statement: The held corpus has no usable longitudinal molecular-to-confirmed-disability dataset for progression.
allowed_scope: Lead the progression section with the missing design and distinguish a coverage boundary from a biological null.
forbidden_overread: Do not say no progression biology exists or that molecular states cannot predict progression.

plain_language_statement: No V54 module became a portable progression-stage marker, and no candidate became a direction-resolved progression target.
allowed_scope: State no progression biomarker, transition, mechanism, target, treatment effect, or means of halting MS was established.
forbidden_overread: Do not collapse no evidence under this design into evidence of absence.

plain_language_statement: Relapsing-to-progressive transition was not identifiable in the seven audited datasets.
allowed_scope: Explain the missing combination of repeated molecular state, changing stage, and repeated disability.
forbidden_overread: Do not label the transition biologically absent.

plain_language_statement: The foamy OXPHOS and lysosomal morphology pattern was downgraded after global multiplicity and within-donor checks.
allowed_scope: Use as a concrete example of an initially interesting pattern becoming exploratory after harder controls.
forbidden_overread: Do not present lesion morphology as a progression mechanism or target.

plain_language_statement: None of ten known packages qualifies for the complete P1 progression, P2 compartment, or P3 functional-direction role.
allowed_scope: Explain the three-step evidence path and why existing packages cannot substitute across roles.
forbidden_overread: Do not describe monitoring cohorts or postmortem morphology as longitudinal progression cohorts.

plain_language_statement: The exact CD44/CXCR4 microglia score is a future progression candidate by identity only; progression prediction is untested.
allowed_scope: State that both genes and a compatible microglial compartment are required and that only score identity transfers.
forbidden_overread: Do not apply the score to PBMC, whole blood, bulk CSF, substitute genes, or old V53 thresholds.

plain_language_statement: A CD44/CXCR4-high MS microglial state was reproduced in bounded analyses, but one discovery partition was strongly brain-bank sensitive.
allowed_scope: Explain the quality-qualified association and the need for a source-balanced donor replication.
forbidden_overread: Do not call it progression-specific, causal, localized across lesion contexts, or a target.

plain_language_statement: Brain-bank or acquisition-source imbalance can mimic a disease signal when source and diagnosis are entangled.
allowed_scope: Use the Cramer's V 0.773 and source-adjusted attenuation as the project's concrete confounding lesson.
forbidden_overread: Do not generalize that every brain-bank result is invalid or that adjustment always solves confounding.

plain_language_statement: Project-grounded findings are rerunnable here; provisional findings have some internal support but still need decisive outside validation.
allowed_scope: Explain evidence grades in plain language and always retain status labels next to claims.
forbidden_overread: Do not use provisional, supported, robust, and validated as synonyms.

plain_language_statement: Outside-source knowledge is kept separate as context and never becomes project evidence merely by being cited.
allowed_scope: Point readers to the separate external index and explain that outside agreement can guide attention but cannot change a grounded result.
forbidden_overread: Do not import outside claims into onboarding as project findings or imply zero recorded contradictions means consensus.

plain_language_statement: Claude, Gemini, and RPT can suggest questions or confusion points, but their output is not evidence.
allowed_scope: Describe models as drafting and adversarial lenses whose concrete proposals require artifact or data checks.
forbidden_overread: Do not cite model confidence, agreement, or prose as a fact.

plain_language_statement: The next clinically relevant test is a frozen external validation of the monitoring score on a correctly structured paired cohort.
allowed_scope: Explain that a pass, fail, or inconclusive result is interpreted under rules fixed before data access.
forbidden_overread: Do not imply that validation is guaranteed to pass or that one small cohort establishes clinical utility.

plain_language_statement: The next progression test requires a microglia-compatible longitudinal package with repeated confirmed-disability data and provenance.
allowed_scope: Explain exact required inputs and the no-proxy rule.
forbidden_overread: Do not substitute relapse, cross-sectional stage, lesion morphology, pharmacodynamics, PBMC, or another score after outcomes are visible.

plain_language_statement: Seeded method simulations indicate that a very small monitoring-validation cohort may remain inconclusive unless the true effect is large and labels are clean.
allowed_scope: Use only to explain validation study design, uncertainty, and why effect-size confidence intervals remain useful after an inconclusive result.
forbidden_overread: Do not treat synthetic effects, power, or confounder settings as biological estimates about MS or as a guarantee about Gafson.

plain_language_statement: The audited public-data search found no fresh ready-to-run primary monitoring-validation cohort; Gafson remains an access request and Karolinska requires response-label mapping.
allowed_scope: Explain verified access constraints and why parallel data requests reduce dependence on one cohort.
forbidden_overread: Do not claim no cohort exists anywhere, count unlabeled longitudinal data as validation-ready, or describe an unsent request as acquired data.
